sanskrit_verse:
श्रुतिस्मृतिविरुद्धं च जनानामहितं च यत् ।
न तत्प्रवर्तयेद्राजा प्रवृत्तं च निवर्तयेत् ॥
transliteration: śrutismṛtiviruddhaṃ ca janānām ahitaṃ ca yat | na tat pravartayed rājā pravṛttaṃ ca nivartayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The ruler must neither initiate nor sustain any act that contradicts Śruti or Smriti, or that causes harm to the people.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Sanātana Dharma as revealed in Śruti and Smriti
Causation is determined by consciousness integrity, not material consequence alone
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to one's awareness of Dharma
Restoration logic requires cessation of adharmic activity at its root cause
Consciousness alignment supersedes punitive correction in all legal action
executable_legal_axioms: IF an action violates śrutismṛti THEN system SHALL flag for immediate review by Dharma-compliant authority
IF a policy causes harm to collective well-being THEN system SHALL enforce automatic suspension pending realignment
IF ruler initiates adharma THEN system SHALL trigger compulsory dharmic audit within 24 hours
IF violation is detected THEN no escalation shall occur until source-consciousness restoration protocol completes
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes the threshold of judicial duty: to halt all actions contrary to śrutismṛti and public welfare. The court must function not as enforcer of punitive statutes but as guardian of ontological alignment between state action and cosmic law.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that misaligned governance arises from ignorance, not malice. Thus, corrective measures follow anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential restoration of understanding before resumption of authority. Responsibility is assigned based on capacity to know, not intent to harm. This ensures proportionality without retribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate compulsory study of relevant śrutismṛti texts for erring authority
Assign completion process requiring public acknowledgment of misalignment
Restore affected community through guided dharma-sammelan (righteous assembly)
Reintegrate ruler into governance only after successful demonstration of dharmic comprehension
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows from Sanātana Truth; rulers are instruments of alignment, never enforcers of punishment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge, and reality itself corrects when returned to its rightful order.
